text: [issue by Lilyy2565] Architectury fails to launch on several NeoForge versions including 26.1 and 26.3 (but it does work fine on 26.2) which is the only version I have tested that works due to an issue with a mixin `MixinBlockTransformer`, this occurs on all NeoForge versions and with only architectury-api installed. I found this issue while attempting to port one of my mods to a multi-platform setup.
